notes.title: Qwepoi Patch 1.3.0 Notes
notes.content:
[b]You guys see the new Qwepoi steam page? It's beatufiul![/b]
[b]And it brings new stuff![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927179/135ea59f03d0b9ebd26b80bea35f2198a567934a.png[/img]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can change the language (only Portuguese for now added);
[*] Simplifies a lot of the controller navigation, START / esc to pause;
[*] Fixes a bug where shots appeared over the ranking;
[*] Fixes the animation bug from ranking up and down;
[*] Fixes a bug that displayed marked options even when sound was muted.
[*] Adds a small tutorial on the initial screen to help players learn the controls without needing to consult the Help.
[*] Now jumping to the highest level is practically instantaneous!
[/list]


These improvements and changes were based on feedback from the Steam page. Thank you, ZeroPantz™, for playing, and also to the Gamescom LATAM event where I showcased Qwepoi to some players. I appreciate the opportunity to continually improve my games!


Join our Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/ks8ShqfVxg]Discord Server[/url]


To keep improving Qwepoi and potentially release new games, stay engaged—I’m thrilled by the positive reception! I hope you enjoy and like it!


Thank you for playing!
Marcos Raoi 🎮🌟

notes.title: Qwepoi Patch 1.2.1 Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed blocked interactions in Menu when opened Ranking;
[*] Fixed Leaderboard not updating;
[*] New Achievement thanking our qwepoi proplayer in Discord Server and his playtest;
[/list]


All these additions and changes were collected through our Discord Server, so I thank you in advance for the opportunity to always improve my games!


Join us on Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/ks8ShqfVxg]Discord Server[/url]


To continue improving Qwepoi, and eventually new games, stay engaged, I'm very happy with the reception! I hope you enjoy and like it!


Thanks for playing!
-Marcos Raoi
